name: DeepL Pro
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For DeepL Pro, connect a local translation memory editor to a user-supplied model API. The hard boundary is deepl's proprietary translation model, document handling, privacy operations, and language quality, plus translation memory, collaboration, and deployment integrations.
